subject: MapleBank: Access controls onboarding — SSO/SCIM/IP & service accounts
messages:
From: Alex Reilly <alex.reilly@maplebank.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Verma <priya.verma@maplebank.com>, security@maplebank.com
Date: 2026-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MapleBank onboarding — initial access controls checklist

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Per the discussion, we want to get the access controls scoped so we can target a May 18th pilot cutover for a small set of internal users. Attached is a spreadsheet of our internal requirements and current tooling (maplebank-reqs.xlsx).

Top items we need to confirm: SSO (SAML) metadata exchange, SCIM provisioning for groups, IP allowlist process for your hosted endpoints, and recommended names/roles for service accounts that Redwood will use for service-to-service calls. Also flagging security@maplebank.com for compliance review.

Can you propose a compact rollout cadence and call out any blockers that would push the pilot date?

—Alex
Head of Identity, MapleBank

-----

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reilly <alex.reilly@maplebank.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MapleBank onboarding — initial access controls checklist

Alex — thanks, and great to meet briefly. Proposed lightweight plan below; happy to adjust by Friday if any of these items conflict with your internal windows.

High-level proposed cadence (pilot target: 2026-05-18)
- Week 0 (this week): Requirements review + SAML metadata exchange + DocuSign for MSA addendum
- Week 1: SCIM attribute mapping, sample groups provisioned to staging
- Week 2: IP allowlist testing against staging; service account provisioning and least-privilege review
- Week 3: Pilot cutover for 10 users + monitoring and rollback window

Blocking items that commonly push pilots:
- Delayed SAML IdP metadata or missing attributes (NameID/email mapping)
- SCIM permissions on your IdP that prevent group writes from our service account
- IP allowlist exceptions for internal proxies that route traffic through dynamic NATs

Action items for this thread:
1) Ben: will send a technical checklist for SAML and SCIM attributes (metadata + sample mapping).
2) Marissa: will share an onboarding runbook and a DocuSign link for the addendum we discussed.
3) Alex/Priya: please confirm team that will sign the DocuSign envelope and provide any compliance template if needed.

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (runbook preview)

Thanks — I’ll loop calendaring for a short technical sync tomorrow if that works.

—Jasmine Liu
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reilly <alex.reilly@maplebank.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-29T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MapleBank onboarding — initial access controls checklist

Alex/Priya — quick technical checklist and clarifying notes. I attached our service-account template (redwood-service-account-template.csv) and a sample SAML metadata file (saml-metadata.xml) to illustrate the fields we need.

SAML checklist (minimum required)
- IdP metadata XML (entityID, x509 cert, ACS URL) — we need your production and staging endpoints
- NameID format: email (recommended)
- Attribute mappings: email, firstName, lastName, groups
- Signed assertions preferred; we can accept unsigned if your IdP requires it during test phase

SCIM checklist
- Provisioning account (service account) with write access to Group and User endpoints
- SCIM schema versions supported (1.1 / 2.0) — we support SCIM 2.0 attributes by default
- Test group names for pilot: map-auth-pilot, map-admins (please create these in staging)

IP allowlist notes
- We host endpoints in us-west-2; current egress IPs are: 3.35.120.0/24, 34.210.45.0/24.
- If you are behind a NAT with dynamic ranges, we can use an outbound proxy or a short-lived VPN tunnel for the pilot.

Service accounts and roles (recommended)
- redwood-scim-provisioner@maplebank (SCIM write, read user/group)
- redwood-monitoring@maplebank (read-only metrics, audit logs)

Please confirm whether your IdP supports group-scoped apps (mapping groups to application entitlements). If not, we’ll fall back to SCIM group sync + in-app role mapping.

—Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-service-account-template.csv, saml-metadata.xml

From: Priya Verma <priya.verma@maplebank.com>

Subject: Re: MapleBank onboarding — initial access controls checklist

Thanks — attaching our IdP metadata (saml-metadata.xml) and answers inline.

Answers:
- We can produce both staging and prod metadata; staging is ready and attached.
- SCIM: Ok to create a provisioning account; we need the exact username and public key fingerprint to bind in our admin console.
- Groups: we will create map-auth-pilot and map-admins in staging by EOD Friday.
- IP allowlist: we run through a corporate proxy that uses a small pool of egress IPs (52.11.77.128/29). Please add that range to your staging allowlist. For production we can give a static NAT range later.

We require that any Redwood service accounts have MFA on the administrative console and that any production-level service account access is scoped to allow only what your template requests. The security team will review the runbook.

DocuSign: who should be the signer for the MSA addendum? I can route to our Legal once you confirm the contact.

—Priya Verma
IT Operations, MapleBank

Attachment: saml-metadata.xml

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Thanks, Priya — this is helpful. Quick confirmation and next-steps so we have a single source of truth heading into the pilot week.

Confirmed items:
- Staging SAML metadata received and validated against our ACS endpoints. No schema issues found.
- Ben: please add 52.11.77.128/29 to staging allowlist and confirm probe results by Friday morning.
- Priya: please create the two staging groups (map-auth-pilot, map-admins) and share the group IDs once available.
- DocuSign: Jasmine — please send the DocuSign to legal@maplebank.com and copy Alex. Marissa will be the Redwood signer for the onboarding addendum.

Proposed concrete timeline:
- 2026-05-03: staging SAML + SCIM end-to-end test complete
- 2026-05-06: runbook review with security (30 min)
- 2026-05-11: service account finalization and production IP range submitted by MapleBank
- 2026-05-18: pilot cutover for 10 users; monitoring window through 2026-05-25

Open risks:
- If MapleBank legal needs redlines on the addendum that delay signature past 2026-05-04 we should push cutover back two weeks to allow for legal turnaround.
- If corporate proxy egress changes during pilot, we will need to use our fallback VPN for traffic verification.

I uploaded the onboarding checklist and the runbook to our Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/MB-MapleBank-Onboarding.

Ben — can you do a quick smoke test of SCIM group creation once Priya confirms the group IDs? We’ll keep security@maplebank.com in the loop for any compliance questions.

Thanks everyone — feel free to ping if you want a short working session this week.

—Marissa Cole
Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf, redwood-service-account-template.csv
